_readme: Client call sites whose server route does not exist yet, on purpose.
Every entry needs path, reason, reference and added, or the gate refuses to
run. A suppression without a written-down decision behind it is not a
suppression, it is a failure somebody forgot.
The gate also fails on a STALE entry: if the server grows a route for an
allowlisted path, the entry has to go. A list that can only ever hide
failures rots until it is hiding a real one.

pending_backend.reason: CallKit + PushKit Stage 2 scaffolding. The JS landed ahead of the backend deliberately: the path is unreachable because setNativeCallKitProvider() is never called outside tests, so isNativeCallKitEnabled() is false and initNativeCallKit() returns before registering a token. EXPO_PUBLIC_NATIVE_CALLKIT_ENABLED is also off by default. Blocked on the COINPLOTXAI INC. app transfer, which has to happen before the VoIP Services certificate can be issued.
The revoke half of the same unbuilt endpoint pair. Same gating, same blocker.
